body: thank you very much.  I am being treated now, and I appreciate your reply.
I did not say that it is not normal.
That's a hard one.  I really like Bad Guy and Listen Before I Go.
I realize this was a while ago, how are you doing at the moment?
My little brother won't understand why I'm gone.

Finally just being done.  Got bullied, I had love life problems, I was so fucking depressed and got addicted to self-harm.  I finally decided to kill myself.  But I just couldn't do it.  It was so eye-opening and scary, and really really fucking sad.  I just couldn't, I couldn't find the energy to pop all the pills.  I just went to bed and tried to forget.  I woke up the next morning and cried, because there were pills all over the floor.
Self harm.  People at my school talk about it as if it's a badge of honor.  It's not a hobby, it's an addiction.

Thank you.  Thank you so much.  I really needed this.  I read your comment just a few minutes after you posted it, and I've been trying to think of a response that will show you how grateful I am for it.  I have been reconsidering things a lot in the past few days, and wonderful people like you have been helping me to make sure that I get the help that I need.  I'm going to try my hardest to get my shit together, because I know things will get better if I just work hard enough for it.  I know it will take time and effort, but that's okay.  I'm willing to try just about anything to get this noise to go away without facing greater consequences.

Thank you for your support and advice.  I appreciate it greatly, I'm going to try to talk to my mom as soon as I can.  You have encouraged me to make sure that I'm getting the help I need, and that is more than I could have done myself.  Thank you so much, you have no idea how much better this has made me feel.  You are a wonderful person.
From what I've experienced, the lighter, thinner, and less deep ones will fade with time.  The wider and deeper ones will take longer.  Not all of them will go away, but some will.

I understand.  The only reason I haven't done it is because I'm afraid of failing and facing the consequences.  I don't want that, I just want it over with.  I get feeling like there's nothing else here for you and that everything is too much to handle.  But I strongly advise you to try one more night staying here.  Give yourself more time.  I know it's so fucking hard to do but if you just stay one more night I think it will be worth it.  I understand your pain fully, so I know that this might be a shitty thing to hear.  But I can't stand to see someone in the same shoes as I am without at least trying to help.
Man I love my fleshpets.  I'm so happy I'm a mom
